sources.label: Morphe patches for Pdb (pdb.app): premium unlock, ad removal, PairIP bypass and
sources.author: Madusha
patch_list: Disables adidas Running's PairIP licence/VM verification, restores the real Application class and bakes the VM's runtime strings (captured from the original app's heap) so Firebase etc. initialize cleanly. NOTE: adidas runs the full PairIP…
Disables the Google Analytics measurement receiver/services and the Adjust lifecycle provider, and sets the Firebase/Google Analytics collection opt-outs.
No-ops the Adjust SDK's event/lifecycle entry points so no attribution or analytics payload is buffered or sent.
Forces adidas Running into its built-in night theme (RtBaseTheme.Dark) by setting AppCompatDelegate night mode at app startup.
adidas Running ships no ad-serving SDK; this denies the advertising ID and the Privacy-Sandbox ad services and removes the install-referrer permission.
